widgets_values:
For the target video, <Picture 1> (Harry's four-view turnaround), <Picture 2> (Draco's four-view turnaround) and <Picture 3> (the Hogwarts great hall interior) are referenced throughout as character and setting references, not as keyframes.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, cel-shaded Japanese TV anime style. Inside the Hogwarts great hall from <Picture 3> at breakfast: four long house tables crowded with plates and goblets, lit candles floating overhead, warm morning light slanting through the tall windows. Draco from <Picture 2> — a proud girl with waist-length platinum-blonde hair, grey-blue eyes and red lips, wearing her Slytherin uniform with a grey pleated skirt and glossy black tights — carries a breakfast tray and walks down the central aisle from frame-left toward frame-right; the camera trucks right at slow speed alongside her. Students at the tables turn their heads to watch her pass. [Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the camera cuts to a static medium shot across the Gryffindor table. Harry from <Picture 1> — a tall boy with messy black hair, green eyes, round glasses and a lightning scar on his forehead, wearing his Gryffindor uniform — sits on the bench at frame-right, facing the camera across the table. Draco enters from frame-left, swings her robe aside, and sits down on the bench right beside him at frame-center; her tray lands on the table with a thud. Harry looks up at her. [Shot 3] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to a close shot of the two of them and pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. Draco, at frame-left, casually picks up the goblet of pumpkin juice in front of Harry at frame-right, takes a sip, sets it down, and raises one eyebrow at him; Harry blinks once, caught off guard. [Shot 4] At 00:07.500, the camera cuts to a static close-up. Harry breaks into a smile and slides his own plate to the middle of the table between them; Draco presses her lips together but her smile escapes, the tips of her ears turn red, and she turns her face away toward frame-left.

overall_soundscape: A bustling breakfast-hall ambience of students chatting, with clinking cutlery and plates throughout. A wooden tray thuds onto the table, a metal goblet is lifted and set back down, and a soft boyish laugh sounds near the end as the surrounding chatter warms back up.

non_diegetic_music: A light, playful arrangement of pizzicato strings and flute at a moderate waltz tempo runs throughout, with a gentle swell of warm strings in the final three seconds.
